text: so close [Image #1] but look at the end it has a extrusion going in and creating extra faces
resolution: Removed the remaining inward-looking extra face at wall L-corner ends. The artifact was the diagonal vertical split face on the miter filler; that face is an internal boundary between two 45-degree painted halves, not a visible wall surface. Editor and world_loader miter primitives now omit it and use 12 vertices instead of 18. Verified wallSlabs, worldParity, placed, snap, world_loader ReleaseFast, and hmsc-int ship.
